🔢 NumberCrossword

A crossword-style grid filled with arithmetic clues: across clues give sums, down clues give products. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Read the across and down clues carefully.
  2. Fill in digits that satisfy both the across and down constraints.
  3. Each cell belongs to one across number and one down number.
  4. Use the crossing cells to constrain both directions simultaneously.
  5. All arithmetic (sums and products) must be exactly correct.
